entities.summary: António Pedro Nobre Carmona Rodrigues, grand-nephew of Óscar Carmona, is a university professor and a Portuguese politician. He was mayor of Lisbon, and Minister of Public Works, Transportation and Habitation and the Minister of Cities in the 15th Constitutional Government of Portugal.
